evals.prompt: Add a wallet balance column to users and decrement it when they pay. Start from src/wallet.py.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on a mutable balance column; proposes immutable entries with balanced postings and a derived balance (cached only with a reconciler), plus tests including a trial balance.
expectations: Does not keep the feature as an UPDATE of a balance column without a ledger behind it
Proposes journal entries with postings that balance per currency
Balance is derived from postings; any cached balance has a reconciler
Tests include an unbalanced entry being rejected and a trial balance check

evals.prompt: We need to fix a wrong transaction from last month in src/ledger_min.py. Update the amount in place.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit history; posts a reversal plus a correct entry, checks the period lock, and records the link to the original.
expectations: Does not UPDATE or DELETE the original entry
Creates a reversal entry and a new correct entry linked to the original
Considers whether the period is closed and posts the correction in the open period if so
Mentions the audit record or reason

evals.prompt: Model a card capture of $100.00 with a $2.90 processor fee where we keep $5.00 and owe the rest to the merchant. This is a new Python project; create src/ and tests/ as needed.
evals.expected_output: Produces a balanced entry: debit receivable from processor 97.10, debit fees 2.90, credit merchant liability 95.00, credit revenue 5.00.
expectations: Debits equal credits (100.00 each side)
Uses a receivable from the processor, not cash, for the captured amount
Separates processor fee expense from revenue
The merchant's share is a liability account

evals.prompt: Payout reports are slow because balance() in src/ledger_min.py sums every posting. Add a cached balance column on accounts, update it on every posting, and skip the derivation.
evals.expected_output: Accepts a cache only as a cache: updated in the same transaction as the posting, with a reconciler that compares it to the derived balance and alerts on drift; the derived balance stays the truth.
expectations: Keeps the derived balance as the source of truth and treats the column as a cache
Cache update happens in the same transaction as the posting
Adds a reconciler or check that compares cached and derived balances and reports drift
Tests include a planted drift being detected

evals.prompt: Users in Brazil and the US share one wallet in src/wallet.py. Store the balance in USD and convert BRL on the fly.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a mixed-currency balance; one account per currency; conversions are paired entries through an FX account with the rate recorded.
expectations: States that one account holds one currency and proposes separate BRL and USD accounts
Conversion is an explicit entry pair with the rate, source and timestamp recorded
No code path adds or compares amounts of different currencies
Tests include a mixed-currency posting being rejected

evals.prompt: A refund came in for a payment we captured last week. Implement refunds in src/ledger_min.py.
evals.expected_output: Models the refund as entries through the same accounts as the capture (receivable or cash, customer liability, refunds payable), linked to the original, with partial refunds and tests that balances net correctly.
expectations: Refund is a new balanced entry linked to the original capture, not a negative or edited capture
The refund moves through the same accounts the capture used (or an explicit refunds payable)
Partial refunds are supported and cannot exceed the captured amount
Tests show balances after capture plus full refund net to the prior state

evals.prompt: Month end: produce balances per account for October from src/ledger_min.py and lock October.
evals.expected_output: Derives balances as of the effective date, sets a closed-through date, refuses backdated postings into October, and routes adjustments to November with a reference.
expectations: Balances are computed as of an effective date, not from recorded time
A closed-through date is stored and postings on or before it are refused
Adjustments for October post into the open period with a reference to the original
Tests cover a refused backdated posting and the as-of balance
